top_signals.title: Oil Rebounds Toward $100 as Democrats’ Sweep Rattles Energy Stocks
top_signals.summary: Oil prices reversed their recent downtrend on Thursday, a day after Democrats swept control of both the House and Senate, creating a potential legislative check on U.S. President Donald Trump’s administration. Brent crude was up 4.0% to trade at $98.38 per barrel at 3:15 pm ET, while WTI gained 2.9% to $90.65, with prices rising for the first time in four sessions after plunging to a near two-month low on Wednesday. U.S. natural gas prices were flat at $2.95/MMBtu, while European gas prices rebounded 1.9% to €89.72/MWh. The U.S. stock…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Japan’s GPIF Suffers First Loss in Six Quarters as Bonds Slump
top_signals.summary: Japan’s Government Pension Investment Fund posted a loss of 1.7% in the three months through September, its first quarterly loss in six quarters, hit by a slump in global bond prices and gains in the yen.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Stock Slump Heads for Europe After Asia Tumbles: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The global stock selloff worsened in Asia, with a regional benchmark dropping the most in more than a year, on concern the US will tighten regulations on the AI industry after Democrats’ decisive election win. European futures also headed lower.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Alpha Dhabi: Long-Term Strategy Include More UAE IPOs
top_signals.summary: Alpha Dhabi has reported group revenue reaching $15.9 billion for the first nine months of 2026, up 6.1% year on year. Derek Nicholson, Chief Strategist & Investor Relations Officer at Alpha Dhabi Holdings spoke to Bloomberg’s Jennifer Zabasajja on Horizons Middle East & Africa on their investment strategy as well as plans for future IPOs. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Chainalysis disclosed password hashes and live tokens were exposed after initially reporting only non-sensitive customer data was accessed.
